source_doc.title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 8-K EX-99.2 CFO Commentary — supply commitments 與客戶端資本安排

sources.quote: Our commitments increased from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion, primarily related to the procurement of memory.
We've partnered with our extensive network of suppliers to secure the critical components needed to meet demand for the next several years.
AI clouds and model makers are seeing extraordinary demand for AI infrastructure, yet many are growing faster than their balance sheets and long-term credit profiles can support.
we have entered into arrangements that help select customers secure the land, power and data center capacity needed to support their growth.
we will earn revenue on the upfront sale of our infrastructure and if certain criteria are met, we will participate in revenue share generated by the AI clouds from their third-party customers.
Securing land, power and shell for data centers has become the next critical phase in the AI infrastructure buildout.
slower consumer PC sales that were tempered by elevated memory and systems prices.
Our upcoming data center leases have terms up to twenty years and are expected to commence between the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 and fiscal year 2033.
We have partnered with leading AI clouds to enable broader access to our AI infrastructure to serve AI startups, model builders, enterprises, research organizations and sovereign customers.
Edge Computing revenue for the second quarter was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago and up 13% sequentially. The increases were driven by strong sales of Blackwell workstations…
Our equity investments are focused on AI model makers, infrastructure financiers, and other private companies, subject to certain contingencies.

claims.statement: In its Q2 FY2027 CFO Commentary, NVIDIA states that commitments increased from USD 119 billion last quarter to USD 279 billion, primarily related to the procurement of memory. This wording is more specific than the same quarter's Form 10-Q, which describes the commitments as being for data center infrastructure systems, primarily memory and manufacturing facilities. The CFO Commentary attributes the increase specifically to memory procurement. No supplier is named, no split between memory types (HBM, DRAM or other) is given, and no per-supplier allocation is disclosed.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if a subsequent filing restates the commitment total below USD 279 billion, or attributes the increase to a category other than memory procurement. 核查頻率：每季 10-Q/10-K 與 CFO commentary；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA discloses that it has entered into arrangements that help select customers secure the land, power and data center capacity needed to support their growth, and that it will earn revenue on the upfront sale of its infrastructure and, if certain criteria are met, participate in revenue share generated by the AI clouds from their third-party customers. The stated reason is that AI clouds and model makers are seeing extraordinary demand yet many are growing faster than their balance sheets and long-term credit profiles can support. This is supplier-side capital flowing toward customers, which is directionally the opposite of customer-side capital commitment and should not be read as evidence of NVIDIA scarcity.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if NVIDIA discloses that these customer financing arrangements have been wound down, or if it quantifies them as immaterial to revenue recognition. Escalate if the revenue-share structures grow to a level where reported demand becomes materially self-funded. 核查頻率：每季財報；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。

claims.statement: NVIDIA attributes part of its Edge Computing revenue mix to slower consumer PC sales that were tempered by elevated memory and systems prices. This is issuer-side acknowledgement that memory pricing is high enough to suppress demand in an adjacent consumer segment.
claims.disproof_condition: Revise if a later quarter attributes consumer PC softness to a different cause, or if memory pricing normalises while consumer demand stays weak. 核查頻率：每季財報；觸發後 48 小時內人工 review。
